design.quote: AURORA is a phase 1b, placebo-controlled, double-blind, 2-centre study of AZD5462 on top of dapagliflozin as standard of care in 2 arms.

population.value: Participants with heart failure with ejection fraction ≤50% and moderate renal impairment (estimated glomerular filtration rate of 30-60 mL/min/1.73 m2, inclusive)
population.quote: Approximately 40 participants with heart failure with ejection fraction ≤50% and moderate renal impairment (estimated glomerular filtration rate of 30-60 mL/min/1.73 m2, inclusive) will be randomized 1:1 to AZD5462 or placebo tablets

sample_size.quote: Approximately 40 participants with heart failure with ejection fraction ≤50% and moderate renal impairment

intervention.value: AZD5462 tablets on top of dapagliflozin
intervention.quote: will be randomized 1:1 to AZD5462 or placebo tablets for a treatment period of 4 weeks

comparator.value: Placebo tablets on top of dapagliflozin
comparator.quote: will be randomized 1:1 to AZD5462 or placebo tablets for a treatment period of 4 weeks

follow_up.value: Treatment period of 4 weeks; dapagliflozin continued until the end of the follow-up period
follow_up.quote: for a treatment period of 4 weeks. All participants will be standardized to 10 mg dapagliflozin prior to AZD5462 administration, and dapagliflozin as standard of care will continue until the end of the follow-up period.
